verdict.rationale: pnpm is a CLI with a dedicated continuous-integration doc page. It automatically switches to frozen-lockfile mode when it detects CI, ships as a self-contained executable that needs no Node.js, and switches to the version pinned in `packageManager`. It also offers machine-readable JSON audit output, and community users report fast CI installs (15s vs 35s). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of non-interactive/no-prompt behavior and concrete CI-provider setup examples in the evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: When pnpm detects that it is running in CI, it switches to frozen-lockfile mode automatically.
It needs no Node.js. pnpm is a self-contained executable, and it can install the runtime for you afterwards with `pnpm runtime set node lts -g`
In a CI environment, installation fails if a lockfile is present but needs an update.
Output audit report in JSON format.
It works very fast in CI, its cache is smaller and it builds node_modules much faster
